fusions.name: Out of Nowhere
fusions.desc: A strike from hiding that deals 34 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and consumes every affliction on the target, adding their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Hidden Pins
fusions.desc: Looses 3 small blades at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Edge in the Dark
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds, and you move 10% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Always Within Reach
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage cannot be resisted. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
